faq.label: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.title: Koi sawaal?
faq.a1: Most WhatsApp Business API providers charge a per-conversation fee (like ₹1.25 per conversation) on top of Meta's official pricing. CartRenew charges ZERO platform markup — you only pay Meta's official WhatsApp pricing. This saves high-volume stores ₹3,000-₹15,000 per month.
faq.q2: Do I need a credit card for the 14-day trial?
faq.a2: No credit card required. Sign up with your email, connect your Shopify store, and start recovering abandoned carts instantly. You only pay when you choose a plan after the trial ends.
faq.q3: How does the auto-withdrawal work for international payouts?
faq.a3: For global customers, we process payouts via Stripe. Your recovered revenue is tracked in real-time and payouts are automatically processed to your connected bank account every Monday. No manual withdrawal needed.
faq.q4: Can I use CartRenew without Shopify?
faq.a4: Currently, CartRenew integrates directly with Shopify and WooCommerce. We're building custom API support for other platforms. Join our waitlist for early access to custom integrations.
faq.q5: AI multilingual messaging kaise kaam karta hai?
faq.a5: Hamara AI engine Shopify profile se customer ka region aur language preference detect karta hai. Phir Hinglish, Hindi, English, ya supported languages mein personalized recovery messages banata hai.
faq.a6: Absolutely. We're SOC 2 Type II compliant and use end-to-end encryption for all data. Your customer data never leaves your infrastructure — we use secure webhooks and never store payment information.
